text: Holding yourself up takes more than you are taking in. Start one weekly session that builds your strength, like swimming or climbing. Grow one plant from seed and give it water each morning. Hand one errand to someone else this month and leave it with them.

Seek Metal, the Order energy. Metal is the line that holds, a rule you did not write and a date you cannot move. Let it shape what Wood keeps growing. Nothing outside you sets your limits. Close one open project this week and say it is done. Let someone else set the end point for one plan.

Your light runs short, and what you make on your own rarely gets seen. Let the rough version out. Play an unfinished song to one friend. Post the drawing with the mistake left in. Bring one thing you made to the next gathering of friends.

Seek Water, the Mind energy. Water is rain on the roots, cool and patient, and it turns the flame down low until the wood grows back. Let it feed the wood that Fire burns. You give out faster than you take in. Listen to one album from start to finish. Wait three days before you share your next idea.
The ground under your plans is thinner than they need. Pick one goal for the season and give it the same hour each week. Tell one friend about it and ask them to check on you in a month.

Seek Wood, your own Body energy. Wood is the trunk under everything you reach for, the body that stands before it carries. Let it hold what Earth piles up. Your load has grown past what one body can bear. Start each week with one thing that is only for you. Say no to one request before you say yes again.

Little of the order in your life comes from outside you. Join one class that meets at a set time. Clear out one drawer and keep only what you use. Set a weekly time with a friend to train or practise together.

Seek Water, the Mind energy. Water feeds the tree from below, and growth returns faster than the knife takes it. Let it heal what Metal cuts. You answer to more rules than anyone has set you. Give one evening a week to learning something nobody grades. Take one whole day this month with no plan and no messages.

Your mind takes in less than it could use. Ask one person who knows more than you and wait for the whole reply. Take one free course on a subject that is new to you. Leave one hard question open for a week before you answer it.

Seek Earth, the Action energy. Earth is bank and field, the ground that gives rain somewhere to stop and something to grow. Let it hold what Water keeps pouring in. No amount of knowing decides for you. Bring one half-done task to the end this week. Fix one broken thing with your own hands.
You run on your existing stores, and that feels like energy until it runs out. Take a class in something nobody pays you for. Start one slow project that will take the whole year to grow.

Seek Metal, the Action energy. Metal is the finished line, the point where a thing is decided and sent on its way. Let it spend what Wood piles up. You keep what you take in, ideas and people alike, because letting go feels like loss. Close one open question this week. Choose one idea to finish and drop the rest.

Your strength runs on what you put back, and putting back is the part you skip. Ask one person for help on a job you usually do alone. Get two friends together once a month just for fun. Stand in the sun for ten minutes each morning.

Seek Water, the Order energy. Water runs cool and keeps to its banks, and a blaze meets it only on the water's terms. Let it shape what your Fire burns. You mistake being unstoppable for being well. Rest one full day a week with no work at all. Let someone finish speaking before you answer.

What you keep inside does not count as finished. Finish one piece of work a week that someone else can hold. Tend one plant or patch of soil through the whole month. Keep a box for the things you have made and open it at the end of the year.

Seek Wood, the Mind energy. Wood is slow growth, roots holding ground and leaves fed by rain, something in you before anything comes out. Let it take in what Earth keeps handing out. Whatever you feel or think leaves you before it has had time to grow. Join one course this month. Give each new idea a week to grow.

Your drive is short, and each piece of it needs a clear place to go. Choose one aim for this month and cross two others off. Sort your open tasks into now, later and never. Clear out one drawer and give away what you have not used in a year.

Seek Fire, your own Body energy. Fire is warmth kept in, the fuel and rest that keep a light lit before it works on anything. Let it hold what Metal spends. You spend your strength on what you claim before yourself, and tired is where you make your worst deals. Eat warm food daily. Talk deals through with a friend.

You do your best work with a date on it and someone waiting at the other end. Ask for honest feedback on one piece of work and just listen. Learn how one new task works before you start on it. Leave an hour empty between two big jobs.

Seek Wood, the Mind energy. Wood is fuel that grows: it drinks the rain and turns it into something a fire can use. Let it hold what Water pours on you. You take every rule to heart faster than you take anything in. Start one project of your own this month. Learn one skill no rule asks for.
You feel most like yourself when your effort has a name and an end. Sign up for one class that ends in a test. Pick one goal for this season and mark the finish on a calendar.

Seek Fire, the Mind energy. Fire is light and warmth the ground takes in, so pressure turns into understanding. Let it soften what Wood presses on you. You meet every demand as if your standing hangs on it. Ask whoever made one rule why it matters to them. Tell one friend each week what is weighing on you.
Your Mind grows on warmth, and warmth is something you have to go and sit near. Once a month go to a talk or a workshop just to take it in. Keep one person to ask the simple question, and ask it.

Seek Water, the Action energy. Water runs down, cools what it touches and carries it away. Let it spend what Fire burns. You have taken in more than you will ever use, and it sits in you unspent. Fix one small thing with what you already know. Pass on one thing you learned to someone who needs it.
Most of what you give up, you give up tired. Wait for the whole answer before you agree to anything. Keep one routine that survives a bad month. Tend one pot of herbs from spring to autumn.

Seek Wood, the Order energy. Wood pushes up through packed soil and reaches for a height it has to earn. Let it shape what Earth stores. You hold your ground even where giving way would cost you nothing. Put one plan up for review before you start it. Take up one new skill with a coach this year.
Your standard is high enough that little ever leaves your hands. Give one thing you made to someone this month, as it is. Cut one draft in half and send the shorter one. Sign one piece of work.

Seek Fire, the Mind energy. Fire is warmth that goes in before anything comes out, the heat that softens what has gone hard and lets it bend. Let it shape what Metal pours. You give out faster than you refill. See one show as a guest, not a critic. Accept the next compliment with a plain thank you.

Your Action grows when it has somewhere to go and something to bring back. Put one plan into motion this season, a trip booked or a small venture opened with money you can spare. Follow one lead you heard about to see where it goes.

Seek Earth, your own Body energy. Earth is the bank and the bed, the ground that keeps water to one course. Let it hold what Water pours. With this much flowing through, little of it ever feels truly yours. Finish one thing you started before you open anything new. Keep one evening a week at home with nothing planned.

You get hardest on yourself when your strength has nothing to build. Give it something. Pick one venture this month and carry it to its first result. Plant one thing this week, a seed or a skill, and watch it grow.

Seek Metal, your own Body energy. Metal is what stays when the wanting stops, the rest under the effort. Let it hold what Wood pours out. You treat rest as time stolen from building. Drop one project you no longer believe in. Choose three things for this month and turn down the others.

You do your best work when someone is allowed to tell you no. Ask someone you respect to grade one piece of your work, and hear the score. Say your doubt out loud the next time a plan is agreed too fast.

Seek Earth, the Mind energy. Earth takes the blaze in and keeps the warmth, ground that does not catch. Let it hold what Fire burns. You answer to pressure faster than you recover from it. Stay with one hard feeling for ten minutes before you act on it. Tend one plant or one friendship with no goal attached.
Your judgment is only as good as the time you let it take. Bring one half-done job from last year to its end this month. Hold a big choice for seven days and see if it still stands.

Seek Wood, the Action energy. Wood draws on the ground it grows from and turns what it takes into something built. Let it spend what Earth stores. You stay with what you already know rather than put it to use. Send the rough draft before the clean one exists. Try a new method on a familiar problem.

You treat rest as something you earn after the work instead of the thing the work runs on. Cut one commitment this month that drains more than it gives. Decide your stopping time before the work begins, and stop there.

Seek Fire, the Order energy. Fire is heat with a deadline that gives your force a direction and a judge. Let it soften what Metal hardens. With no one above you, you answer only to yourself. Say your plan to a person who can refuse it. Share one unfinished piece of work with three people this month.
What you have to give runs short, and it counts for nothing until someone hears it. Tell someone one story with no lesson in it. Ask one person what they took from it, and listen to the end.

Seek Earth, the Mind energy. Earth is the ground under the water, the bank that stills it until it clears. Let it hold what Water pours. You let it all out as it comes, and nothing stays in long enough to settle. Keep one piece of news to yourself for a week. Hold to one plan for a whole month.

Your output comes in bursts, and the slow work in between stays hidden. Take one idea you dropped last year one step further. Tell one person about a plan you have kept quiet. Add ten minutes to the same project every day for a month.

Seek Metal, the Mind energy. Metal is the cold side water forms on. It pulls from the air and hands the water back to its source. Let it hold what Wood pours out. Nothing you let out will fill you back up. Bring one piece to its end before you begin the next. Drop one plan this month for good.

Most of your chances are lost by never being claimed, not by failing. Tell three people about the venture you have in mind. Ask once for the price you think your work is worth. Put the idea in front of a real buyer this month.

Seek Water, your own Body energy. Water is the deep you draw from, the sleep and food and slow fill that come before anything is lit. Let it hold what Fire burns. Whether you are reaching for more or guarding what you have, the heat comes out of your own reserves. Take one slow weekend. Let the numbers wait.

You carry every line you live by alone, since few deadlines come to you from outside. Put yourself under one. Sign up for the race, the exam or the course with a date on it. Hold one fixed hour each week for it and do not move it.

Seek Metal, the Mind energy. Metal is the clear line that sorts a demand into what is asked and what is feared. Let it hold what Earth presses on you. You take each demand as a judgement on yourself. Cut one task this week that nobody asked you for. Ask what is needed, then do that much and stop.

You let in less than the world has to offer, and the gap shows when a question needs more than you hold. Pick one hard question and collect three answers before you decide. Sort what you hear into what you will use and what you will drop. Clear one hour a week for a subject outside your field.

Seek Fire, the Action energy. Fire melts what has gone hard, so a checked thought becomes an act and the extra look burns off. Let it spend what Metal stores. Each extra round of care buys you safety and costs you a move. Ship one piece as a draft. Share one rough idea with a group this week.

Every push you make draws on a reserve that was small to begin with. Rest a full day after any big push. Ask a friend for the whole answer rather than guessing it. Hand half of one shared task to a peer.

Seek Earth, the Order energy. Earth is the bank: it gives moving water a path and a shore. Let it shape what your Water pours. You hold more than you move, and what you do not move turns into weight. Finish one job you have put off before Sunday. Keep the same day each week for one steady task.
